name: - DYNA
fix_description: In deposit, when user adds more stake (firstStakeAt != 0), lastProcessAt is not updated. getInterest calculates reward as principal * duration where duration = now - lastProcessAt. Attacker deposits small amount, waits, then deposits large amount (inflating principal without resetting time), then immediately redeems for oversized interest. Fix: settle pending interest before updating principal on subsequent deposits (pendingReward += getInterest(); lastProcessAt = block.timestamp).
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is multi-step and protocol-specific: it uses a flash swap, manipulates the token’s sold-amount restriction via tx.origin behavior, and farms staking rewards across many helper contracts after a time warp. While the PoC is not extremely long, understanding why the repeated deposit/withdraw across 200 contracts works and how the transfer limit is bypassed requires more than spotting a simple bug.
